verdict.rationale: Algolia documents official API clients for JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Swift, Kotlin and .NET, says they are covered by its SLA, and maintains an agent skill that migrates client code to the latest major versions. Its official InstantSearch UI libraries are corroborated by community users across several platforms. missing for 10: in-depth per-SDK reference or usage documentation in the evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of the backend API clients themselves (community praise is mostly about InstantSearch).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Official clients for JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Swift, Kotlin, .NET
The official API clients are covered by Algolia’s Service Level Agreement
Migrate API client code to the latest major version (JS, Python, Go, PHP, Java, C#, Ruby, Kotlin, Scala, Swift)
InstantSearch.js is an open source UI library for vanilla JS that lets you build a search interface in your frontend app.
